programs.sub_title: The One With The Home Study
programs.desc: Monica and Chandler fuss over their apartment as they expect a visit from the adoption worker. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Mike opt for a small wedding and donate the extra money to a children's charity.

programs.title: Friends
programs.sub_title: The One With The Late Thanksgiving
programs.desc: Monica reluctantly agrees to cook Thanksgiving dinner, but locks everyone out when they turn up late as Joey and Ross went to a hockey game while Rachel and Phoebe took Emma to a baby beauty contest. Monica also receives some adoption news.

programs.title: Friends
programs.sub_title: The One With The Birth Mother
programs.desc: Monica and Chandler are forced to pretend to be a reverend and a doctor when their prospective child's birth mother gets the wrong end of the stick. Meanwhile, Joey's date with Phoebe's friend doesn't go well, and Ross is left with an inappropriate outfit for a date with a sexy salesgirl.

programs.title: Friends
programs.sub_title: The One Where Chandler Gets Caught
programs.desc: When Rachel and Phoebe catch Chandler getting into a car with a blonde woman, they assume he is having an affair.

programs.title: Friends
programs.sub_title: The One Where The Stripper Cries
programs.desc: Joey appears on quiz show The $100,000 Pyramid, but his disastrous efforts to answer the questions end up costing his partner the prize money. Meanwhile, the revellers at Phoebe's hen party get a surprise once the stripper shows up. Guest starring Danny DeVito and Donny Osmond.

programs.title: Friends
programs.desc: It's Phoebe and Mike's big day, but all does not go to plan. Wedding planner Monica is driving the bride to distraction, New York is hit by its worst blizzard for 20 years, and Joey is taking his role standing in for Phoebe's incarcerated father far too seriously. Chandler and Ross are upset that neither of them has a role, until Mike needs to replace one of his groomsmen.
